_doc: Batch 1: sfx die je hoort op de WM1-rookroute (titel, Wachtershuis, Wilgendal, Archief 1 t/m Golem). Sleutel = sfx-id uit audio_manifest.json. prompt = Engels voor Stable Audio Open; seconds = lengte om te genereren; max_s = lengte na trimmen (tools/check_algemene_sfx.py eist nu <= 0.60 s). Variaties (bestanden _01, _02, ...) komen uit het manifest; elke variatie krijgt een andere seed.
_style: 16-bit era JRPG sound effect, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail, single hit
_negative: music, melody, song, speech, voice, reverb, noise floor, distortion, low quality

menu_click.prompt: short dry mechanical click, a small cog locking into place, UI click

menu_hover.prompt: very soft tiny tick, UI hover blip

menu_confirm.prompt: two rising metallic chime tones, positive UI confirm

menu_cancel.prompt: short descending metallic tone, UI cancel back

menu_error.prompt: dull low buzzing reject sound, UI error

menu_open.prompt: mechanical panel sliding open with a short hiss of steam

menu_close.prompt: mechanical panel sliding shut with a soft clack

dialogue_blip.prompt: tiny retro text blip, single short beep, typewriter dialogue tick

dialogue_advance.prompt: small soft click, dialogue box advance

load_game.prompt: clockwork winding up followed by a soft click
